name: Clover Residence
shortDescription: A gated community of 33 large villas in Si Sunthon, right beside HeadStart International School, completed in 2024 by GOOD TEAM 888.
description: A gated community of 33 large villas in Si Sunthon, right beside HeadStart International School, completed in 2024 by GOOD TEAM 888. Three layouts with 3 to 5 bedrooms are offered, many with private pools, and listings show built areas of roughly 340-470 sqm. Later phases (The Valley Phase II, Luxe Zone Phase III) are separate nearby projects.
furniture: Varies by listing: fully, partly or unfurnished
parking: Parking ratio 200%, conventional, no EV charging
